task.title: Page recurrence occurrence histories
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/973 to page complete typed occurrence histories through bounded authored-offset windows.
acceptance_criteria: Return present complete histories in ascending authored-offset order with a deterministic next_offset.
Omit sparse gaps while advancing the cursor by inspected authored coordinates.
Validate every selected present history before return and fail without a partial page on selected corruption.

attempts.diagnostic: The page tests failed because RecurrenceStore::occurrence_histories_page did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added bounded sparse-page, cursor, validation, missing-recurrence, and selected-corruption coverage.

attempts.summary: Implemented and refactored the bounded slice.
attempts.diagnostic: Implemented recurrence-local authored-window paging and extracted one canonical complete-history projection path shared by exact and paged queries.
attempts.patch: Implemented issue 973 in crates/vela-kernel/src/scheduler.rs with focused tests, ADR-0087, and behavior documentation.

attempts.diagnostic: Independent review found no blocking implementation or API issues; an initial rate-limited CodeRabbit status was excluded, then genuine exact-head review completed with no actionable comments.
attempts.patch: Preserved the unchanged verified head through cooldown and required zero unresolved threads before merge.

outcome.summary: Issue 973 delivered bounded sparse paging over complete occurrence histories with deterministic cursors and fail-closed selected-window validation.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 974 exact head

lessons: Paging complete histories should reuse the exact-history projector so strict lifecycle semantics have one authority.
Sparse cursors advance by inspected authored coordinates, not by the number of returned histories.
The page grants no global discovery, mutation, persisted cursor, catch-up policy, dispatch, or execution authority.
